General.Description:
Hidden beneath five centuries of Cambodian jungle growth, the temple complex known only as Site Seventeen has been a rumour among archaeologists for decades — referenced in a single line of a sixteenth-century Portuguese missionary's diary and dismissed as legend ever since. Professor Hana Inoue has spent twelve years proving it is not a legend. She is now one day's walk from finding out she is right.

The Jade Temple is an immersive archaeological adventure that plunges its characters into the hidden world of Cambodia's unmapped interior. Kai Yamamoto draws on years of research into Khmer history and temple architecture to build a site that feels genuinely ancient — full of deliberate design, hidden chambers, and the quiet menace of a place that was meant never to be found.

When Hana's expedition is ambushed by a private security team working for an antiquities dealer with connections at the highest levels of two governments, the race to document and protect the site becomes a race for survival. Yamamoto handles both the intellectual excitement of discovery and the physical peril of pursuit with equal assurance.

A gorgeous, propulsive adventure grounded in real history.
